name: scripture-sous-chef-web
description: WebAssembly bindings for scripture-sous-chef — a pure, addressable content analyzer for scripture text

scripts.build:wasm: npm run build:wasm:bundler && npm run build:wasm:web
scripts.build:wasm:bundler: wasm-pack build crates/wasm --target bundler --release --out-dir ../../pkg-bundler --out-name sous_chef_web && node scripts/restore-wasm-package-layout.mjs
scripts.build:wasm:web: wasm-pack build crates/wasm --target web --release --out-dir ../../pkg-web --out-name sous_chef_web && node scripts/restore-wasm-package-layout.mjs
